assets.name: Aegis-1 LEO Earth Observation Constellation
assets.location: 550 km Sun-Synchronous Polar Orbit (97.4 deg inclination)
assets.standard_operating_procedure: Orient solar arrays to edge-on drag-minimization profile; increase orbit-maintenance thruster readiness; defer non-critical optical sensor deployments during high-latitude auroral oval transits.

assets.name: Celestia-4 Geostationary Broadcast & Telecommunications
primary_hazards: Deep dielectric discharge from relativistic electrons (>2 MeV)
Star tracker disorientation from energetic solar protons
assets.standard_operating_procedure: Enable autonomous safe-hold orientation; switch attitude control to inertial gyros if optical star trackers report high noise; shed non-essential internal electric heaters to suppress bus voltage transients.

assets.name: Laurentian 735 kV Northern Extra-High-Voltage Grid
primary_hazards: Geomagnetically Induced Currents (GIC) in grounding neutrals
Bulk power transformer half-cycle core saturation
Harmonic distortion and abnormal reactive power consumption
Potential voltage instability and tripping of protective relays
assets.standard_operating_procedure: Reduce power flow on transmission lines operating at >90% thermal limits; engage reserve static var compensators (SVCs); cap long-distance high-voltage DC tie-line transfers; alert regional transmission balancing authorities.

assets.name: Transpolar Flight Corridor Polar-1 (Arctic Airway)
assets.location: Arctic Navigation Routes (FL330 - FL410, North of 60 deg N)
primary_hazards: Polar Cap Absorption (PCA) causing High-Frequency (HF) radio communications blackout
Loss of Communications (NORDO) over oceanic and arctic tracks
Elevated crew and passenger cosmic ionising radiation dosage
assets.standard_operating_procedure: Reroute scheduled transpolar flights via southern sub-polar airways; verify SATCOM CPDLC as primary communications medium; prepare step-descent flight plans to FL290 if solar radiation storm escalates to S3.

assets.name: Sub-Millimeter & High-Frequency Radio Astronomy Array
primary_hazards: Solar radio noise bursts in L-band and S-band
Ionospheric scintillation causing phase decorrelation during interferometry
assets.standard_operating_procedure: Stow ultra-sensitive cryogenic receiver feeds on sun-facing dishes; suspend interferometric calibration cycles; shift observing schedule to planetary radar or solar-burst observation mode.
